spec_match.rationale: A decision aid mapping six real scenarios to renderSizeHint recommendations grounded in the explainer and origin-trial guidance; it makes no capability claims and links the live-probe pages for real measurements.

interactive.rationale: Six keyboard-operable scenario cards (role=button, tabindex, Enter/Space handlers) drive the verdict panel with recommendation, rationale, trade-offs, and a code snippet.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card's promise matches the page's verified behaviour.

edge_cases.rationale: The warn block states plainly that these are heuristics and real apps must benchmark, linking the latency and stress pages; no API calls exist to misreport.

references.rationale: See-also now includes the ChromeStatus entry (added in this refile) plus the sibling live-measurement pages.

conformance.rationale: The new v153 feature suite ran in the verification browser at 5 pass / 4 fail / 0 blocked — the 4 fails are the shipped-attribute assertions, the honest 'not yet shipped' answer on Chromium 141 (anticipated Chrome 153), exactly as their descriptions state.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP page-driver run (headless Chromium 141): selecting the OfflineAudioContext scenario rendered its verdict (largest-you-can, render-to-buffer rationale); console/network clean; screenshot v153-rq-picker.png read.

telemetry_health.rationale: This page is a static decision aid with no probe outcomes to assert; no telemetry asserts were added, matching its no-API-claim design.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons that override background also override color; small-text emerald readouts darkened via color-mix to meet AA.

accessibility.rationale: Cards are role=button with tabindex=0, aria-pressed state, and Enter/Space activation; the selected state is conveyed by aria-pressed plus the rendered verdict, not colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/webaudio-configurable-render-quantum --no-server: desktop OK clean, mobile OK (sub-44px flags are inline links, primary buttons/sliders remain usable); both screenshots read and judged clean.

openQuestions.title: Cross-check the recommendations against post-ship reality
openQuestions.detail: Once Chrome 153 ships the hint, sanity-check the six recommendations (especially the battery claim for large player quanta) against real measurements from the latency and quality-lab pages and update the copy if the guidance shifts.

guidanceConsulted.query: web audio start stop controls live metrics readout accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give async result areas polite live regions, keep state changes textual, and disable/re-enable controls around async work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Scenario cards keep full keyboard operability (tabindex, Enter/Space, aria-pressed); verdict is plain text and code.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Driver run: offline card selection updated the verdict panel

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let card grids collapse to one column on narrow viewports and keep wide code blocks scrolling inside their own container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: case-grid is one column below 700px; trade-off grid wraps.

summary: v153 refile of the decision aid with a ChromeStatus link added; recommendations unchanged (still explainer-grounded). Verified via CDP headless Chromium 141: card selection and verdict rendering work with a clean console.
